notes.title: DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia Deluxe Edition contents currently not accessible
notes.content:
Currently, people who purchased the DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia Deluxe Edition are unable to access the Deluxe Edition contents:

- Digital Art Collection (13 Pages)
+ Character art collection
+ Rough art collection
- 2 Audio Dramas in Japanese and Drama Script in English and Traditional Chinese (PDF)
+ Natsumi Encounter
+ Origami Friendship
- Official Soundtrack (27 tracks)
- Short Novel in Japanese, English, and Traditional Chinese
+ Ren Masques

Idea Factory International is aware of this issue and is working to resolve it promptly. Thank you for your understanding and patience.

notes.title: DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia is OUT NOW! + Teaser Trailer Live
notes.content:
Idea Factory International are excited to announce that the latest game in the DATE A LIVE universe, DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia is out now for Steam®! 

To celebrate this release, you can get a sneak peek at the dark mysteries that await Shido and the Spirits with the all-new DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia Teaser Trailer:

[previewyoutube=mDHWPrgJ_2U;full][/previewyoutube]

If you already own the first game in the series, DATE A LIVE: Rio Reincarnation, on Steam®, you qualify for a 10% Complete the Set Bundle discount on DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia. 

You can also grab either the base game of DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia game or the Deluxe Edition with a 15% weeklong launch discount.

The Deluxe Edition Includes:
- Digital Art Collection (13 Pages)
+ Character art collection
+ Rough art collection
- 2 Audio Dramas in Japanese and Drama Script in English and Traditional Chinese (PDF)
+ Natsumi Encounter
+ Origami Friendship
- Official Soundtrack (27 tracks)
- Short Novel in Japanese, English, and Traditional Chinese
+ Ren Masques

* You can access the Deluxe Edition contents in the game folder. Right-click the game in your Steam Library, select "Browse Local Files", then open the "Assets" folder.

Check out the official DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia website for more information on the game. 

Purchase the game on Steam® today!
